topics.name: Member Identity Rules
topics.purpose: Define when members/topics/behavior/constraints/edges require explicit independently referenceable identities.

semantics.referenceable_rule: Any independently cross-referenced member requires exact id.
semantics.constraint_rule: Invariants/gates require stable ids in owner scope.
semantics.position_rule: Array position never substitutes permanent identity.

invariants.rule: Every conformance rule has exact identity, scope, inputs, predicate/evaluation semantics, severity/blocking behavior and finding representation.
Conformance rules never rely on newest-wins, mtime, filename similarity, path proximity, UI layout, fuzzy identity matching or undocumented implementation defaults.
